title: Block coordinate
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $k$, each $t\in\{0,\ldots,(r+1)k-1\}$ has a unique pair of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,r\}\times\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ under the standard finite product indexing; define its block coordinate to be the first coordinate.
